claims.title: Persistent task recovery design
claims.statement: The fictional project document proposes persisted task state, bounded retry and heartbeat lease recovery.

source_refs.claim: Documents a proposal, not an implementation.

evidence.claim_text: The source explicitly identifies itself as a fictional design.

narrative_unit.situation: Tasks may fail while executing dependencies.
narrative_unit.actions: Persist state and use bounded retry, idempotency keys and worker leases.
narrative_unit.verified_results: Design described; implementation and production impact are not established.
